title: pdflatex: command not found on Mac after installing MacTeX (PATH fix)
short_title: pdflatex not found after MacTeX? Fix your PATH

verify.notes: The symptom was captured with a PATH that lacks the TeX folder. MacTeX writes /etc/paths.d/TeX, read here from a real install; only new login shells read that folder. The export line is the standard fix given in the cited threads.

scenes.title: pdflatex: command not found
scenes.sub: MacTeX is installed, but Terminal cannot see it.
scenes.narration: If you installed MacTeX and Terminal still says pdflatex: command not found, the tools are there. Your shell just does not know where to look.

scenes.label: Terminal
scenes.narration: This is the message. Editors that call pdflatex report the same thing in their own words.

scenes.text: MacTeX puts its programs in /Library/TeX/texbin. A shell only finds them if that folder is on its PATH.
scenes.narration: MacTeX puts its programs in the folder /Library/TeX/texbin. A shell only finds them if that folder is on its PATH. The installer adds it through a small file in etc paths d, but only new Terminal windows read it, and a PATH line in your zsh startup file can overwrite it.

scenes.label: Terminal
scenes.narration: First, look at the file the installer wrote. If it names the texbin folder, the install is fine and the problem is in your shell.

scenes.label: Terminal
scenes.ui: Add the PATH line to the file, then save. Close every Terminal window and open a new one if you would rather not edit the file.
scenes.narration: Open your zsh startup file and add a line that puts the texbin folder on your PATH. Then reload the file, and run pdflatex with the version flag. If it prints a version, you are done. Otherwise close every Terminal window and open a new one.

scenes.name: ModernTex
scenes.line: Uses MacTeX or TinyTeX, and offers a one-click TinyTeX install in the editor when it cannot find one.
scenes.narration: If you write LaTeX on a Mac, ModernTex uses MacTeX or TinyTeX, and if it cannot find one when you compile, it offers a one click TinyTeX install in the editor.
